title: Towing and Storage Payment Caps, Insurer Program Agreements
content:
The insurer's payment for towing and for storage on its claims is capped by the tier of its agreement under the Insurer Program Agreements:

- **Towing cap** — the most the insurer pays for one tow to the center, in US dollars.
- **Storage cap** — the most the insurer pays per day of storage on its claims, in US dollars per day.

| Agreement tier | Towing cap per tow (USD) | Storage cap per day (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | 150.00 | 45.00 |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | 150.00 | 45.00 |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 175.00 | 45.00 |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 175.00 | 50.00 |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | 200.00 | 50.00 |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 225.00 | 50.00 |

## How a cap reads

A cap is the most the insurer pays; a tow or storage day billed at or below the cap is within it, and the insurer's payment for one billed above it stops at the cap. The towing cap applies to each tow to the center separately; the storage cap applies to each storage day separately.

## Cases (hypothetical amounts)

| Case | Tier | Billed | Most the insurer pays |
|---|---|---|---|
| One tow | Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 190.00 | 175.00 |
| One tow | Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 190.00 | 190.00 |
| Four storage days at 60.00 a day | Select Direct Repair Agreement | 240.00 | 45.00 a day, 180.00 for the four days |
| Four storage days at 48.00 a day | Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 192.00 | 48.00 a day, 192.00 for the four days |

The billed amounts are invented for the cases; only the caps come from the table.
